name: openFDA Recalls Agent
description: Read-only agent over openFDA enforcement reports: recent drug, food and medical device recalls, keyword/firm/state/class search, counts by classification, lookup by recall number, and a watch skill that POSTs when a new recall matches your filters. Every answer is read live from openFDA and carries openFDA's own unvalidated-data disclaimer. This hosted endpoint answers recalls-recent, recall-search, recall-lookup; the local server additionally implements recalls-summary, recalls-watch.

skills.name: Recent recalls
skills.description: The newest recall records from openFDA enforcement reports, across drugs, food and medical devices, newest report date first. Filter by scope, classification, state or date window.
examples: what was recalled in the last 7 days?
any Class I food recalls this month?

skills.name: Search recalls
skills.description: Search the recall registers for a product, a firm, a reason or a state — for example romaine, a company name, or 'undeclared milk'. Counts and dates are openFDA's.
examples: any recalls by firm Crown Farms?
recalls mentioning undeclared milk in CA

skills.name: Look up a recall
skills.description: One recall record by its recall number, for example H-1331-2026 or D-0835-2026. Returns the firm, product, reason, classification, status and distribution.

metadata.note: The local Python server implements every skill on its own card, including watch loops and push notifications. This hosted card lists only the skills the hosted endpoint answers.
